name: Macro Recorder Lite
headline: RECORD -> DO IT -> REPLAY
description: Record short keyboard macros by performing them once. Macro Recorder Lite captures key down/up events, combinations and timing on Windows, then lets you assign the recording to a Stream Deck key and replay it without writing scripts. Great for keyboard shortcuts, hotkeys and simple automation. Mouse recording, long macros, loops and Macro Library are available in Pro.
release_notes:
- Record keyboard key-down/key-up events, shortcuts and timing.
- Assign the latest recording to any Replay Macro key and edit event delays.
- Includes ready-to-use starter profiles for standard Stream Deck, Mini, XL, Plus, and Neo with REC / STOP / PLAY and safe keyboard examples.
- Adds a global Stop action and Ctrl+Shift+F12 emergency playback stop.
tagline: Record keyboard workflows once. Replay them from Stream Deck.
privacy: Macro contents are never uploaded to PackRat. Lite stores assigned macros in local Stream Deck action settings; if the user exports or shares a Stream Deck profile, those action settings can be included in that exported profile.
pro_url_policy: Do not populate until a verified direct Macro Recorder Pro Marketplace URL exists.
limitations: Playback uses the Windows SendInput API and may be blocked when the target app runs at a higher Administrator integrity level than Stream Deck.
Windows secure desktop, including UAC secure prompts, is outside normal recording and playback.
